title: Quick DNA Extraction for Fungal Barcoding (X-Amp)
author: Stephen D Douglas Russell

steps.title: Prepare Sample Cells
steps.instruction: Set up 96 0.2mL cells on a 96-well PCR plate rack, preferably using 8-strips with individual caps. Label cells with Run #, plate #, and row number, filling plates from right to left.

steps.title: Add Fungal Tissue
steps.instruction: Add a small amount of fungal tissue to each cell, filling from right to left. The amount should be small enough to drop to the bottom of the tube.

substeps.instruction: For dried specimens: break off a small section, further break up with tweezers on a Kimwipe or white paper to reach desired size.
For fresh specimens: pull desired amount of tissue directly from the specimen.
Wipe tweezers with a Kimwipe between specimens.

steps.title: Add X-Amp DNA Reagent
steps.instruction: Add 15 µL to 25 µL (typically 20 µL) of X-Amp DNA Reagent (IBI Scientific Catalog #IB47441) into each cell containing tissue.

steps.title: Submerge Tissue and Spin Down
steps.instruction: Ensure tissue is completely submerged in the fluid and remove air bubbles, then centrifuge the strips.

substeps.instruction: Tap down each strip with a finger to remove air bubbles and ensure tissue is submerged.
Spin down each strip for 10 seconds in a mini centrifuge.
Double-check that tissue is in the fluid after spinning.

steps.title: Incubate Samples
steps.instruction: Heat the tubes containing tissue for 01:00:00 at 80 °C in a thermocycler.

steps.title: Add Molecular Water
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of Molecular Water (IBI Scientific Catalog #IB42130) to each cell and replace the caps.

substeps.instruction: If the liquid remains very dark, add a second 100 µL aliquot of Molecular Water.

steps.title: Thermal Shock (Optional)
steps.instruction: Microwave the samples for 2 minutes to disrupt the cell wall further.
